place.name: Sri Kamadchi Ampal Temple (Hamm)
place.description: The Sri Kamadchi Ampal Temple (Tamil: ஸ்ரீ காமாக்ஷி அம்பாள் ஆலயம்) is a Hindu temple (mandir) in the city of Hamm, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. Dedicated to the goddess Kamakshi, a form of Tripura Sundari, it was built largely by Sri Lankan Tamil refugees and consecrated on 7 July 2002.
